novelty_flags.label: prop:published-subclass-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: Its three indegree-two bounds are exactly the published HSM subclass bounds specialized to s=2, so it cannot remain a root to-prove novelty target.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:total-stopping-schedule
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The total formula-returning schedule assumes that oeq:sharp-frontier has first derived the uniform cutoff B2.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: A total degree-B2 formula schedule conditional on a proved sharp recursive-degree frontier.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 7, Propositions 7.1–7.3; Appendix C proofs of Propositions 7.1–7.3, including the auxiliary-cutset polynomial bound.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For maximum directed indegree s, the paper proves identifying degree at most 2s+1 for HTC and instrumental-cutset identification, and at most s^4+2s^3+s^2 for auxiliary-cutset identification; all disturbance coordinates are placed after structural ones. At s=2 these are 5, 5, and 36.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 40(3), 2012, version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes a polynomial-time sufficient half-trek criterion for generic identifiability and reports exhaustive algebraic computations for graphs through five vertices.
Instrumental cutsets recursively identify direct structural coefficients by determinant ratios and provide a polynomial-time identification procedure.
Auxiliary Cutsets provides a polynomial-time structural-coefficient identification algorithm subsuming several efficient criteria.
The paper gives a sound and complete generic-identification algorithm in polynomial space, and states generic edge identifiability is decidable in PSPACE.
The preprint derives influence functions, asymptotic normality, variance estimation, and Wald inference for fixed half-trek estimators.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Remove prop:published-subclass-reduction as a root novelty theorem and retain it only as a cited reduction lemma with the explicit HSM propositions and s=2 substitution.

Make the sharp-frontier OEQ's lower-family route operational by specifying a first graph gadget family and the exact valuation/Hilbert or inverse-multidegree invariant it must preserve under every earlier-coordinate adjunction.

Promote the strict separation from the known bounded HTC/IC/AC subclasses into a corollary of the frontier: either exhibit an explicit indegree-two rationally identifiable family outside AC or state that its construction is a required deliverable.

recommended_next_step: Revise by demoting the published subclass-bound proposition to background, then advance the order-free sharp-frontier OEQ as the field-level kernel.
